findings.finding: No hosted Bucket-01 workflow is included. Exact-head execution and retained reports must be supplied separately.

One exact-head registry binds four independent closed-form benchmark oracles and two frozen production convergence/location definitions by Git blob SHA, raw SHA-256 and canonical JSON hash. Production output is prohibited from generating expected values, selecting coordinates or setting tolerances.
The production annular T6 ladder is independently checked for geometry, Jacobians, midside placement, symmetry, connectivity and feature sets.
Material, load and restraint mapping coverage remains dependent on retained production execution.
The governed T3 patch covers plane stress and plane strain, exact displacement, stress, energy, load parity, equilibrium and deterministic replay.
The T6 patch covers distorted geometry, rigid motions, scaling, rotation and Jacobian rejection.
The governed pure-shear receipt covers affine displacement, tensor and derived stress, energy, load-path parity, equilibrium and replay.
The T6 pure-bending panel covers quadratic displacement, linear integration-point stress, energy and moment equilibrium.
The 64/256/1024 production ladder has frozen force, moment and strain-energy convergence contracts plus retained-result receipts.
Dense Cholesky is retained for small systems and deterministic CSR/Jacobi-PCG is used above 1536 DOFs. The exact 1024-element production run is not retained.
Element-local probes reconstruct unrounded tensors from retained T6 integration points without nodal projection or cross-element averaging.
A governed T6 Kirsch benchmark uses frozen off-boundary probes and fixed-coordinate GCI against a closed-form oracle.
Two standalone lug probes and a five-station radial path are frozen before stress observation and map uniquely at all production levels.
The production stress receipt requires zone-specific three-level GCI at every frozen coordinate. No production stress PASS is claimed.
The fail-closed code-basis contract is implemented, but no externally approved governing code, edition, allowable, classification or load combination is supplied.
The custody contract requires exactly three distinct exact-head replay bundles with identical evidence, stdout, stderr and required report hashes. No repository replay PASS is claimed.
